The 64-pixel unit-sun fixture is generated by `scripts/bake_transfer_fixture.py` using Blender Cycles, a white diffuse plane and unit white sunlight. Direct and indirect diffuse are baked without material color, matching the garden bake pipeline. It is test data, not a garden asset. The JSON records native float values and the saved PNG hash. `test_bake_transfer.gd` compares the production bake shader with Godot Compatibility dynamic lighting on a gray plane; all RGB channels must agree within 0.01.
